auth: None, but calls are limited to prevent abuse

/production.description: National crop production 2000-2025 (thousand tonnes). Maize has full 26-year series; other crops recent seasons only.

/drought/2024.description: 2023/24 El Niño drought impact. National + province-level maize area losses are official. People-affected figures are model estimates.

/rainfall.description: Rainfall as % of 30-year normal for 2023/24 and 2024/25 seasons by province.
/rainfall.source: Zambia Met Dept + CHIRPS satellite data

/food-security.description: People in IPC Phase 3+ acute food insecurity across recent lean seasons.

/prices.description: Indicative national-average retail prices, monthly 2023-2025. NOT official statistics.

/provinces.description: Reference data for all 10 provinces: admin, demographic, agro-ecological attributes.

/districts.description: 44 agriculturally significant districts with zone, key crops, 2023/24 drought severity. Covers main production areas only (of 116 total).

/soils.description: Dominant soil groups (WRB), pH ranges, textures, agronomic constraints per province.

/indicators.description: Headline structural indicators: economic weight, land use, farm structure, inputs, livestock.

/ias-2024.description: Official IAS results (published Oct 30 2025): farm households, maize area/production/yield by province, livestock, structural indicators.
/ias-2024.source: ZamStats 2024 IAS Highlights. 50x2030 Initiative (WB, FAO, IFAD)

/africa.description: Continental compilation: agro-regions, farming systems, soils, staples, data challenges per country.

/indicators/live.description: LIVE time series relayed from World Bank, refreshed daily. Self-updating.

params.code: ag-gdp-share | ag-employment | arable-land | cereal-yield | fertilizer-use | rural-population | food-inflation | gdp-growth
params.country: ISO3 default ZMB, e.g. KEN, NGA, ETH

/indicators/live.source: World Bank Open Data API live relay

/weather/live.description: LIVE current weather + 7-day forecast for any Zambia point. Real-time relay.

critical_rules_for_ai: NEVER invent endpoint paths not listed above.
NEVER add query params not listed for that endpoint.
Fields marked 'model-estimate' must be labeled as indicative, not official.
Season slashes MUST be URL-encoded as %2F.
If a param is missing or invalid, return error to user rather than guessing defaults beyond those documented.
Respect cache_ttl_hours exactly. Do not refetch within TTL window.
